opis: Everything with a motor: shutters, blinds, awnings, curtains, gates and garage doors. Moves at motor speed, weather behind the glass, window sensors.

karta.domOpis: All Motor HA devices on one card: state, reason for move and buttons.
karta.domBrak: There are no Motor HA devices yet.

urzadzenie.co: Pick a shade from Home Assistant and name the window.
urzadzenie.poco: The card controls this shade and shows its real position.

oslona.co: Pick the shade type you have at home.
oslona.poco: The card draws this material. Outdoor shades are shown from the facade.

kolory.co: Pick the shade colour and the window frame colour.
kolory.poco: The window on screen looks like your real one.

okno.co: Set the number of sashes, the height and the buttons.
okno.poco: Each sash can have its own shade and move on its own.

czujniki.co: Pick the window opening sensors (contact sensors).
czujniki.poco: The card shows a tilted or open sash.

silnik.co: Enter the motor speed or the full travel time.
silnik.poco: The shade on screen moves as fast as the real one.

pogoda.co: Pick the weather outside and the card language.
pogoda.poco: Sun, rain, snow, fog, day and night behind the glass.

ui.wUrzadzeniu: This window comes from the Motor HA integration. Changes are saved straight to the window device, so every card of this window looks the same.
ui.bezUrzadzenia: You can pick any shade. A window added in the Motor HA integration also has calibration and keeps its settings in the device.
ui.brakCzujnikow: There are no window sensors in this shade's room. You can pick them yourself.
ui.czasZPredkosci: Full travel: {0} s (from motor speed {1} rpm).
ui.czasNauczony: Full travel: {0} s (learned from real moves).
ui.czasDomyslny: Full travel: {0} s. The card learns the real time after a few moves.
ui.jezykAuto: As in the Home Assistant profile
ui.pogodaInternet: There is no weather entity in Home Assistant. The card will get the weather from the internet (Open-Meteo) for your home location.

pomoc.entity: A Motor HA window, a group of two blinds or a single blind.
pomoc.roleta_lewa: Empty = taken from the window or group.
pomoc.odwroc: When the motor reports 100 % with the shade closed.
pomoc.osobno: Dragging the glass moves only this sash.
pomoc.auto_czujniki: Window sensors from the same room.
pomoc.predkosc_lewa: A number entity with the motor speed (e.g. Moes, Tuya). Empty = found on the device.
pomoc.pogoda: Empty = the first weather entity in HA, otherwise weather from the internet.
pomoc.widok: Drawn houses, trees and street lamps.

symulator.wskazowka: Drag the glass or use the buttons. This is only a preview – nothing at home moves.

urzadzenie.brakPaneli: There is no editable dashboard. Create one in Settings → Dashboards.
urzadzenie.blad: That didn't work. Please try again.

pytania.uklad: What does the window look like?
pytania.rodzajBrama: What kind of gate is it?
pytania.przypisz: Tap a pane of the window
pytania.czujniki: What Motor HA knows about the home
pytania.auto: What should happen on its own
pytania.dzwonek: Where and what to notify about

podpisy.silnik: All covers from Home Assistant. Ones already used in another device are labelled.
podpisy.przypisz: Each pane: a motor and a sensor. Suggestions are already filled in.
podpisy.czujniki: Found in the room and in the home. Tap to turn off or change.
podpisy.auto: Nothing moves on its own until you turn it on.
podpisy.stoper: The covers go up, down and up again. The drawing will move at this pace.
podpisy.gotowe: This is how the card will look on the dashboard.

kreator.wlasnyTytul: Custom layout · drag the lines and the bottom of the window
kreator.wlasnyPodpis: Tap a pane, then split or remove it. Up to 4 columns and 3 panes in a column.

auto.blokada: Don’t close on an open window

kreator.autoPodpis: Wind and rain appear here when you add such sensors or weather.
kreator.pomin: You can skip this and measure later with the device’s “Calibrate” button.
kreator.odRazu: The motor reports the end right away. Set the motor speed or skip.
kreator.brakTelefonu: Without a phone, notifications appear only in Home Assistant.
kreator.przypiszPodpis: Tap a sash in the drawing to pick its motor and window sensor.
kreator.oknaWieczorem: In the evening, with window sensors
kreator.pozniej: Once you close the window, the cover finishes on its own.
kreator.zamienPodpis: Grab a sash in the drawing or ⠿ on a row and drop it on another to swap them.
kreator.rodzajCalosc: Tap a pane in the drawing to give it a different type or colour.
